# ResearchPocket

ResearchPocket 2.3.0 is a local-first personal library for useful HTTP(S) URLs
and bounded private Zen documents. The static public site explains the product;
the owner app stores its replica in the visitor's browser. No private library
or token is bundled in the public shell.

Available now: offline URL capture and curation; CLI and TUI; V1 SQLite import;
native bookmarklet capture; optional direct/Firecrawl enrichment; separately
stored captured Markdown; private GitHub sync, checkpoints, and restore;
browser library profiles; Zen Markdown, todos, and saved-item mentions;
a derived library graph; TUI documents; opt-in remembered browser tokens.

Planned: selective public collections/publication, the loopback web server,
broader import/export formats, background-service installation, and the
item-aggregate migration. Zen documents already use their own sync aggregate;
saves still use protocol v1. Contracts and ADRs may include target behavior.

Current browser updates beyond the published 2.3.0 release add Zen link
completion on [[, an Insert link picker, research:zen/<uuid> document links,
internal saved-item navigation, and on-demand Linked from backlinks. These
are local presentation and Markdown features, not a persistent relationship
index. Native completion and item-note completion are not included.
